title: Is it possible to consolidate the whole security program
description: This content discusses the concept of consolidating cybersecurity tools and programs into a unified security platform, referred to as 'platformization.' It is based on a study by IBM and Palo Alto Networks exploring how such platforms can generate business value by bridging silos among multiple security tools. The discussion is conceptual and does not describe a specific vulnerability or exploit.

aiSummary: The provided information centers on the idea of a unified cybersecurity platform that integrates multiple security tools into a single cohesive system to improve operational efficiency and security outcomes. The source is a study by IBM and Palo Alto Networks titled 'Capturing the cybersecurity dividend,' which examines how platformization can reduce detection and containment times and lower costs in sectors like banking and telecom. The content is a discussion and inquiry about the feasibility and existence of such platforms rather than a report of a security threat or vulnerability.
